links.comparator_used: Unstructured 'humane' dialogue without prompt engineering, versus structured conversation with minor prompt engineering (few-shot prompting)
links.outcome: Consistency of LLM responses when updating the hydrocele and varicocele guideline chapters
links.effect: Improved consistency with basic prompting versus humane dialogue; no numerical effect reported (60 conversations analysed)
links.tradeoff: Overall reproducibility, consistency and reliability still judged inadequate despite basic prompting; high variability between repeated runs persisted, and the LLMs could not access the scientific databases needed to include recent literature.
links.quote: The use of basic prompting in the structured conversations compared to the humane responses improved the consistency of the responses.
